- CAMCatalogEnrichmentValidator — validate()
- reports per-CAM coverage from all three indexes
- computes overall_score as weighted combo (0.5/0.3/0.2)

- passes when current ≥ baseline (no regression)
- detects regressions when current < baseline × (1 - drift)
